events.continuity_hook: Adds a brief logistics check to the already booked Santa Fe weekend after the hotel parking note arrives.
events.interaction_goal: Update the Friday arrival plan, parking approach, dinner timing, and Monday airport buffer without changing the reservations.
events.scenario_brief: The Plaza-area hotel sends a note about Friday evening street closures near the square, and Jonah’s spouse wants an easy first-night dinner rather than improvising after the Albuquerque pickup and drive. The booked flights, hotel, and rental car stay in place; the only items to tighten are the airport-to-Santa-Fe drive buffer, valet approach, dinner reservation choice, and Monday return timing.

events.continuity_hook: Starts a new conference planning episode after the Santa Fe weekend details are settled.
events.interaction_goal: Create a practical flight-and-hotel shortlist around booth setup, customer meetings, downtown dining, and the uncertain Thursday departure window.
events.scenario_brief: Jonah is assigned to a Denver water-technology conference with Tuesday afternoon booth setup, Wednesday customer meetings, and Thursday breakout sessions. He needs Bay Area-to-Denver flight options that either arrive Tuesday morning or give him a calmer Monday afternoon arrival, plus hotel comparisons between the official convention block and a better-reviewed nearby property with easier restaurants. The open question is whether teardown keeps him until late Thursday or allows a Thursday early-evening return.

events.continuity_hook: Continues the Denver conference planning after booth access and the Wednesday dinner location become firmer.
events.interaction_goal: Narrow the outbound flight, hotel choice, and likely return window while accounting for the earlier booth access and Wednesday dinner.
events.scenario_brief: The conference office moves booth access to late Tuesday morning, and a manufacturer dinner lands near Union Station on Wednesday night. Jonah wants to narrow the trip between a Monday afternoon nonstop that gives him prep time and a Tuesday morning option that is cheaper but leaves little room for delay. For hotels, he is weighing the official block rate against a nearby property with stronger guest feedback and quieter rooms. The remaining open item is whether a teammate can handle the final freight handoff Thursday afternoon.

events.continuity_hook: Finalizes the Denver conference plan once the teardown handoff and return window are settled.
events.interaction_goal: Book the conference flights and hotel, add the room request, select seats, and summarize the booth and meeting schedule.
events.scenario_brief: The booth teammate agrees to handle the last pallet handoff, so Jonah can leave after his Thursday afternoon customer meetings. He books the Monday afternoon Bay Area-to-Denver nonstop, a Thursday early-evening return, and the better-reviewed convention-adjacent hotel rather than the official block. The room note should request a coffee maker and mini-fridge if available, and window seats should be selected where possible.

events.continuity_hook: Starts a new utility site-visit episode after the Denver conference booking is complete.
events.interaction_goal: Build a flight, rental-car, and hotel shortlist that protects the early Wednesday gate time while leaving room for a possible Thursday meeting.
events.scenario_brief: A Central Oregon municipal utility asks Jonah to run a membrane-startup walkthrough and operator training at a Bend treatment facility, with a Wednesday 6:30 a.m. gate time and a possible Thursday council debrief. He needs Bay Area-to-Redmond flight options for Tuesday that leave enough time for rental-car pickup, the drive to Bend, and slide review that evening. Hotels should compare a Redmond airport property with simpler arrival logistics against a Bend hotel closer to the facility and dinner options. The unresolved items are whether the Thursday debrief is added and whether the demo skid paperwork clears before travel.

events.continuity_hook: Moves the Central Oregon utility trip from comparison to booking once the debrief timing and equipment paperwork are settled.
events.interaction_goal: Finalize the flights, rental car, hotel reservation, room request, seat choices, and concise site-visit agenda.
events.scenario_brief: The utility confirms the Thursday debrief ends near noon and the demo skid paperwork is cleared. Jonah books the Tuesday afternoon Bay Area-to-Redmond nonstop rather than a cheaper connecting option, a compact rental car, and the Bend hotel with solid guest feedback, parking, and nearby restaurants. The room note should request a coffee maker and mini-fridge, and the return should be set for late Thursday afternoon with window seats selected where available.
